results.title: Blind Spot
results.overview: An unconventional experimental animated horror film presented as recovered security footage from a Singapore office building that mysteriously burned down at 4:44 a.m. Framed as archived files, the film presents seemingly mundane CCTV loops of an empty hallway, a stairwell, and an office. As time goes on the footage glitches and deteriorates until eventually revealing something unnatural.

results.title: Topol: On Top of the World
results.overview: Through a personal archive and portraits he painted throughout his life, the film returns to the moments he chose, and to those in which he almost missed the roles of his life. From them, a much more complex man than the charismatic star he is known for is revealed. An actor, inventor, and institution figure, who began to direct more and more of his energy elsewhere, away from the spotlight.

results.title: Edwin: In Technicolor
results.overview: When struggling TV salesman Edwin’s life begins to fall apart, he is forced to navigate and confront the absurdity of his life.

results.title: There Are No Rules
results.overview: After a freak sun incident leaves the world without color, one man is inspired to quit smoking.

results.title: Home 79
results.original_title: ផ្ទះក្រោយ៧៩

results.title: The tits of Juliet, the balls of the bull
results.original_title: Els pits de Julieta, els ous del toro
results.overview: "The tits of Juliet, the balls of the bull" explores —through the editing of social media footage— the collective act of touching public statues, particularly on their intimate parts, and everything this gesture reveals about contemporary culture.

results.title: Beneath the Beams of Noon
results.overview: The continuation of a life diary, positioning personal joy, loss, and spiritual turmoil within the macro-rhythms of nature.

results.title: What We Missed
results.overview: After being blindsided by sudden breakups, two heartbroken friends agree to spend a week fulfilling the bucket-list dates they never got to share with their exes

results.title: Smoke
results.overview: This evocative and visually striking film explores the urgency and fear at the heart of the climate crisis.

results.title: Bed to the Future
results.overview: A young Scottish queer couple visit a futuristic bed shop where a simulator promises to reveal the perfect future for their relationship. Only it’s not quite what they had imagined.

results.title: Un-static
results.overview: A young man summons a Unicorn in search of answers about identity, belonging and purpose, embarking on a magical journey between the weight of the past and the promise of the future.

results.title: Still Alive
results.overview: Hector wakes up, cloned into a younger body by a dubious biotechnology company, his only company, a temp worker, at the end of a very long shift. He soon discovers that a second chance at life may not be everything he hoped for.

results.title: Optimum
results.overview: Two strangers meet for a date in a Glasgow beer garden. An AI system has declared them to be optimally matched. There’s no need for guess work or uncertainty. But can an algorithm really predict love?

results.title: Broth
results.overview: After an on-air meltdown derails her career, former news anchor Rona Lawson is sent to report from a disappearing coastline. There, an unexpected friendship helps her discover that the future is not yet written.

results.title: My Enemy, My Body
results.overview: Diagnosed with ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis), artist Juan Secaira faces the inexorable deterioration of his body by taking refuge in painting, poetry, and the company of his family.

results.title: The Shadow
results.overview: After committing a crime, Santiago and his brother take refuge in an isolated house, where they hold a woman hostage and encounter other unsettling inhabitants. What seemed like a hiding place soon turns into a labyrinth of darkness.
